title: SOPHIE at the Observatoire de Haute-Provence
what_was_studied: Fibre-fed spectrograph architecture, observing modes and initial performance
numerical_result: High-resolution mode covers about 387 to 694 nm at resolving power near 75000
remaining_question: Initial specifications predate the octagonal-fibre and red-camera interventions

title: SOPHIE plus first results of an octagonal-section fiber for high-precision radial velocity measurements
what_was_studied: Illumination scrambling and RV repeatability after the 2011 fibre change
numerical_result: Stable-star repeatability improved from 5 to 6 m/s to about 1 to 2 m/s
remaining_question: The result is sample- and era-specific and does not describe the later red-camera configuration

title: The SOPHIE search for northern extrasolar planets VIII
what_was_studied: Nightly instrumental zero-point correction from a stable-star ensemble
numerical_result: The correction reduced long-term systematics in the analysed SOPHIE data
remaining_question: A shared ensemble correction can absorb astrophysical signals unless targets and validation periods are separated

title: Ultraviolet astronomical spectrograph calibration with laser frequency combs from nanophotonic lithium niobate waveguides
what_was_studied: Visible and near-ultraviolet comb generation tested on SOPHIE
numerical_result: Comb features below 400 nm were recorded; overlapping line-spread-function wings limited contrast
remaining_question: A calibration demonstration is not a stellar long-baseline precision result

title: French national telescope call semester 2026B
numerical_result: The call scheduled installation in April 2026, shared-risk availability in June and nominal operation from 2026B if no major problem occurred
remaining_question: A dated completion or achieved post-upgrade characterization is still required
